decisions.reason: The transactional email service is the firm's flagship and matches its cloud enterprise messaging strategy, so it will be kept and developed further.
Email-fax conversion runs cheaply on existing infrastructure and still serves regulated customers such as healthcare and public institutions, though fax demand is slowly declining.
The fax delivery optimization feature is built into the established fax service and costs little to maintain, but fax is in long-term decline and the feature may be absorbed into the core service.
Sandbox threat protection meets rising demand for advanced email security against ransomware and phishing, which strengthens the security portfolio.
Multi-engine virus scanning is a core part of the secure messaging offer and is unlikely to be withdrawn.
